parts: All right. Let's give those two models the same quiz.
好，给这两个模型同一张小测。
Ten little sums. Nothing fancy.
十道简单加法。
One finishes. The other finishes.
一个做完了，另一个也做完了。
Both hit the ceiling. Where would a better model go?
都碰到天花板了。更强的模型往哪儿放？
Now slide in a few questions they actually have to think about.
换上几道真得动脑的题。
The scores can move apart again.
分数终于拉开了。
That's benchmark saturation: the test has run out of room at the top.
这叫基准饱和：卷子顶上没空间了。
Hold on to that little sum.
先留住刚才那道小题。
Suppose I have no idea and pick a tile at random.
假设我完全不会，随手点一格。
Only the gold one pays out.
只有金色那格能得分。
Now watch what happens when six wrong answers slide in.
看，六个错答案插了进来。
Same sum. Same correct tile.
算式没变，正确选项也没变。
The gold slice takes up less of the space I can land in.
能蒙中的那片却变窄了。
We've changed the odds of a lucky guess, while the arithmetic stayed put.
变的是蒙对的机会，算的还是同一道题。
M M L U spread multiple-choice questions across dozens of subjects.
MMLU 的选择题横跨几十个学科。
Its Pro version made the choice sets bigger and the questions harder.
Pro 版增加选项，也提高难度。
It cleaned up ambiguous questions, too.
它还清掉了有歧义的题。
The authors compared answering directly with working through the problem first.
作者比较了直接答和先推理再答。
Working it through helped more on the new test.
在新版里，先推理更有帮助。
G P Q A brought in subject experts to write questions a quick search couldn't settle.
GPQA 请学科专家出题，搜一下也难答。
Humanity's Last Exam screened submissions against strong models.
人类最后考试用强模型筛选来稿。
Some of the questions that survived even need a picture.
有些留下来的题，还得看图才能做。
Now try a job from my phone. Help me cancel today's appointment.
换成手机上的活儿：帮我取消今天的预约。
Both replies get the cancellation across.
两份回答都把取消说清楚了。
One leaves room to pick another day.
有一份还顺手问了要不要改天。
I might like that. You might just want to get on with your day.
我也许喜欢，你也许只想赶紧办完。
So hide the names and ask which reply people would actually use.
先盖住名字，再问大家真想用哪份。
People can pick either one, or call it a tie.
可以选任意一份，也可以打平。
That's the idea behind Chatbot Arena.
Chatbot Arena 就是这么收集偏好的。
Each vote connects just two models.
每张票只连起两个模型。
Blue beats purple. Purple beats gray. Gray can still beat blue.
蓝赢紫，紫赢灰，灰也能赢蓝。
We keep all three results.
三场结果都留下。
Fit scores so their gaps predict the pattern of wins as well as possible.
给模型拟合分数，让分差尽量解释胜负。
Close scores mean a tight match, for this crowd and these questions.
对这群人、这类问题而言，分近就难分胜负。
Waiting for people is slow when you're testing changes all day.
要是一天改好几版，等真人投票就慢了。
So give a model the judge's seat. How does it decide?
那就请模型坐上裁判席。它会怎么判？
Give it a job: check that the cancellation is clear.
给裁判一条规则：看看有没有说清取消。
And check for any promise the reply just made up.
再看看有没有凭空作承诺。
The judge picks the first reply on the left.
第一轮，裁判选左边。
Watch the two slips. Keep every word; swap the order.
盯住两张纸：字不动，互换顺序。
It picks left again.
它又选了左边。
That's a different reply! The vote followed the seat.
可回答换了！票是跟着座位走的。
Judge both orders and keep track of the flips.
两种顺序都判，单独记下翻票。
Leave the slips where they are now.
这回，纸条的位置固定。
Pad the reply on the right. Just repeat what it already says.
给右边加点字，只把原意再说一遍。
And the vote swings over.
票居然转过去了。
Train against that score and the model has a shortcut.
用这分数训练，模型就找到了一条捷径。
Say the same thing, then say it again.
同一件事，说完再说一遍。
There's your length bias.
这就是长度偏差。
What if we cut every answer down to the same size? Hold that thought.
把所有答案剪得一样长？先等一下。
Keep the answers intact. Put length difference along the floor.
先保留原答案，把长度差放在横轴。
Now lift the estimated win rate above it.
纵向抬起来的是估计胜率。
Alpaca Eval learns the pattern from many comparisons.
AlpacaEval 从许多对照里估计关系。
It accounts for the model and the question, as well as the length.
长度之外，也考虑模型和题目。
Walk back to zero. What win rate does the fit predict at equal length?
走回零：一样长时，估计胜率是多少？
Average those predictions across questions.
把各道题的预测胜率取平均。
If the extra line gives me a new appointment time, people might want it.
多出来的是改约时间，真人可能真需要。
So check that kind of change with people, too.
这种有用的变化，也交给真人试一试。
By the way, I'm about to close that chat.
说起来，我正要把聊天关掉。
The cancellation message reads beautifully.
那句取消通知写得挺漂亮。
Look behind it. The appointment is still in my calendar.
看看后面：日历上的预约还在。
We judged what the model wrote.
刚才我们判的是它写了什么。
Now I want to know what it can get done.
现在要看它能把什么事办成。
Give it the tools, stand back, and check what actually changed.
把工具递给它，再看看事情到底变没变。
